title: Proper geometric Frobenius operation and exchange wrappers
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a proper $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $a_Y:Y\to s$, $g=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times h$, and $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for geometric Frobenius. Use the integral and raw rational coefficient operations and exchange recipes of [def-weil-operation-exchange-coefficient-descent]. At the canonical identity compactification $Y_0\xrightarrow{\operatorname{id}}Y_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$, select the direct model when $c=\mathrm{false}$ and the compact model when $c=\mathrm{true}$, exactly as in [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport]. Define $R^{\mathcal O_E}_c:D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ to be modelFunctor of that selected model, and define its exchange $Lh^*R^{\mathcal O_E}_c\to R^{\mathcal O_E}_c Lg^*$ to be modelExchange of the same model. Define $R^E_c$ and its exchange by modelRationalFunctor and modelRationalExchange with exactly those arguments, the prescribed raw scalar localizations. The case $c=\mathrm{false}$ is ordinary derived direct image and the case $c=\mathrm{true}$ is compact-support direct image with the retained identity compactification; no comparison between them is asserted here. Supply the canonical residue-field invertibility instances for $\ell$ on $s$ and $Y$, respectively from frobeniusPointPrimeInvertible and sfWeilPrimeInvertible of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. No Weil structure on the input object is required: that last input is used only for its prime-invertibility construction.
